facts.business: Transrail Lighting Limited is a diversified EPC and turnkey organization with strong capabilities across transmission lines, substations, civil construction, railways, poles and lighting, and solar EPC, supported by integrated manufacturing facilities and engineering expertise.

capacity_or_capex.item: Integrated manufacturing facilities (tower factories at Deoli, Butibori, Vadodara; conductor factory at Silvassa)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Continue strengthening scale by expanding manufacturing capacity, engineering capabilities and execution excellence; expand horizons by deepening presence across geographies; deliver trust by consistently creating value through quality and reliability

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding search and seizure proceedings by Income Tax Department under Section 132 at various premises; management views no material adverse impact; opinion not modified

key_risks: Search and seizure proceedings by Income Tax Department with unascertainable consequential impact
Contract revenue recognition involving significant accounting judgements in estimating costs to complete EPC contracts
Execution risk across 63 countries with diverse geographies
Dependence on order book conversion and project execution
